sections.overview:
Affiliate marketing is a performance-based marketing platform that connects merchants, affiliates, and customers to drive relevant traffic and increase sales. The skill covers how affiliate marketing works through key players—merchants, affiliates, affiliate networks, and customers—and explains the mechanics of earning commission through product promotion. For business owners and beginners, affiliate marketing offers measurable benefits including performance-based payment models, audience expansion, brand credibility, cost-effectiveness, and increased traffic. Affiliates only earn when conversions or sales occur, making it a low-risk, results-driven strategy to boost brand visibility and generate high-ROI revenue streams.
E-commerce businesses expanding sales through affiliate partner networks
New startups building brand awareness with low upfront marketing costs
Publishers and content creators earning passive commission income
Brands entering niche markets like automotive, health, or financial services
